scope: Fresh full actual-file mathematical audit of all three units, followed by actual read of the F_q-base correction.

correction_observed.issue: An arbitrary characteristic-p base need not contain F_q; the fixed q-Frobenius scalar sheaf need not be constant.
correction_observed.saved_repair: W is over F_q; coefficient-base extensions are F_q-algebras. Surface applications remain over the fixed algebraically closed k.
correction_observed.independent_detection: B independently detected the same issue contemporaneously with D; the saved repair was then reread.

checks: Rotated Frobenius product gives genuine sigma-semilinear cyclic deck descent on the fixed F_q local system.
The categorical d-cocycle imposes no spurious order-d relation on a based lift in pi1(W).
The fixed determinant is counted on H before the degree-d cover, avoiding a degree-d loss.
e=f/d stages on degree-td cover give f t r^2 variables at fixed ordinary normal depth and constant equation degree.
Deck pullback preserves fixed Cech opens, normal order, slopes and reference constants, including the final phase.
All-Artinian Lang-frame nilpotent invariance and finite unit-Isom construction apply also when p divides d.
Twisted Shapiro formulas, factor-coordinate transport and cocycle orientation are correct.
Outer-action injectivity ensures trivial centralizer and a monolithic primitive group; fixed unramified P has at most 2g generators.
Ambient conjugacy loss is at most q^(r^2); LMT estimates yield exactly the stated c and generator bound.
The example SL_(p^a)(F_(p^f)) retains the nonabelian-simple qualification and the existing natural-order estimate.
